QuestInfo.name: [Magatia's Secret] The Truth About Dr. De Lang
QuestInfo.1: After reading the #t4161031#, #p2040050# realized what #p2111002# wanted not really that big of a deal. He felt sad about the whole thing. While reading the note, #p2040050# realized there was a hidden message at the end. He said that #b#p2020005##k might be able to reveal the hidden message. #b#p2020005##k just so happens to be in Magatia.
QuestInfo.2: A great alchemist who served as the 3rd president of the Alchemist Union in #m261000000#... That's #p2020005#.

0.0: What #p2111002# wanted was... actually that. He seemed to be so happy that he fell in love with someone... and for him to take this extreme measure... sigh. What #p2111002# wanted was in fact, so trivial and empty like this. I guess love painted #p2111002# in the corner.
0.1: Wait a minute, there's something off about this note. It looks like there's a huge blank space at the end. It appears some sort of solution was applied to hide a secret message... I am sorry, but I don't know how to reveal it. But... I may know someone who can.

yes.0: The only person who can read the note's hidden message is #b#p2020005##k. As one of the alchemy masters, he should be in Magatia, so ask him yourself.

no.0: If you are not interested, then I don't know what to say...

1.0: Hmm? What is it? What? You want me to extract the hidden message in this note? Let me see what this note is about...

npc.0: Haven't you met with #b#p2020005##k yet? He's currently conducting experiments at #b#m211000000##k, so I suggest you make your way there soon.

lost.0: I found out you lost #t4161031#. There are so many people passing through, that someone found this dropped note, and it found its way back to me. It took me a while to regain this note, so please don't lose it again.
